maddeler.t: Inherited from Proto-Semitic *lā. Compare Hebrew לֹא (lo), which, in older texts, is used in the negative imperative and the negative existential indicative.
g: not; negates an indicative present-tense verb
do not; expresses prohibition with a jussive verb
there is not, there is no, there is nothing, nothing is
not; negates any non-verbal sentence element
A negation particle used to convey a prayer or wish.
